plugin.name: xGRIB
plugin.summary: Display, download, and generate environmental GRIB files.
plugin.author: Paul
plugin.description: A catalogue-installable GRIB viewer with integrated generation of combined weather, wave, and current GRIB files using an isolated native helper. Disable bundled GRIB before enabling xGRIB, then restart OpenCPN. Requires OpenCPN with plugin API 1.21 and a matching platform package. The Windows x86 plugin requires a 64-bit Windows system for its separate native generator.
